notes.title: Ready Player One mode!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28302138/04ccf027a3c28b4a1c2b72e9698460ed1b038058.png[/img]

Have you already seen the “Ready Player One” film or read the book? We’ve got so inspired by it that we’ve decided to introduce a new mode at the time the most important movie about virtual reality hits the movie theaters!

Now you will be able to enter an absolutely new location from the main menu. 
Here is a list of what you can meet there:

1)[b]Protect the artifact from robots.[/b]  There are 7 waves of enemies and 3 new types of them: giants, regular and fast robots, who run towards the dome faster than other robots. And the dome is the only protection your artifact has! Besides you, of course.

2)[b]Absolutely stunning retro music.[/b] It will be a lot of fun smashing the robots while listening to addictive beats!

3)[b]Weapons you’ve been already introduced to:[/b] the Hammer and the Gun from multiplayer. In order to receive the latter, you will have to work some stuff out and reach the 3rd wave. The Gun will appear right on the location, all you will need to do is to grab it and use it to destroy everything around you using two hands. Also you can take 2 pistols at once!

[h1]The rules are simple:[/h1]
Destroy waves of enemies with style
Protect the artifact under the dome, its HP can be seen on top
If the dome is destroyed - it is not that horrible, there is still you to prevent the enemies from destroying the artifact. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28302138/bd211e5c1966a0854a6fe8d1dacaad6743041d3a.png[/img]

Hope you will enjoy the new mode! :8bitheart:

notes.title: Multiplayer!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/11BDL2KAPYDjzZkQXe/giphy.gif[/img]

Hey-ho dear friends :) I have only three words for you: Robots, Revolver, Ready.

We've finally launched a test version of the multiplayer mode!

[h1]Multiplayer is in open ALPHA now[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28302138/966a4a84340eb9b2bb327935be3dd4dad13166e3.png[/img]

We've already told you a lot about PvP, but now you will be able to launch its test version! Hooray!

[h1]New weapon: Revolver![/h1]

Unexpected, eh? SURPRISE! In the test version of the multiplayer mode, a huge revolver which shoots rockets awaits you! By the way, nobody canceled the benefit of making headshots. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/NTiA5lxauph4ny3h0u/giphy.gif[/img]

And a lot more stuff you love the robot for: throw the fragments, fight using skyscrapers, use a house as a shield or a shelter, though it won't be able to handle a lot of bullets. 

[h1]How to start[/h1]

Find a small city on the world's map with two red robots and teleport to it.

To start a match you just need to click [b]"Create a game"[/b] or, if you want to join your friend, click [b]"Join"[/b]. EZ!

A bit of info about the rules:
[olist]
[*]Shoot the enemy using weapons, throw buildings at him.
[*]Do not leave the enemy reactor area. You will die if you do so.
[*]When the time of the match runs out, the one who made more kills wins. 
[/olist]

If you've encountered any bugs, please tell us about them and we will do all that will be needed to fix the issues as soon as possible.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/60rV8xAmXLwb5CfV9f/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Robot vs Robot
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28302138/e5e3e50c84895bdc54221bfecda3c8ee9c957004.png[/img]

Hello, friends! 
Today we want to share a lot of information about the upcoming multiplayer!

When we’ve decided to choose “Player VS Player” concept for the multiplayer, we’ve encountered a lot of problems and difficulties: starting with maps what we had in the game already - they were not suitable for this mode. Same goes to the teleport system, which could have given a big advantage or disadvantage to certain players. And the fact that we had absolutely no idea how one player should see another player in the game was just another issue in this list.

That was exactly the time when we came to ask for your help! I’m sure you remember us posting sketches and voting polls.

We are excited to show you the results of our hard work:

[h1]VRobot’s model[/h1]
We’ve added the Robot’s model to game. In the new mode, you can actually "touch" your opponent.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUOwGgGGBVUD1IMLPa/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]Interaction[/h1]
We’ve added the interaction between the environment and the enemy - now you can throw houses at him, and in the future - use different types of weapons.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xThtal2RwybpYn6MA8/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1]New map and locomotion[/h1]
We’ve prepared a new map with two respawn points on it. We’ve also added an absolutely new element to the game - the energy reactors. While the enemy's reactor is active - the player is protected with a shield. In order to disable the enemy’s shield you need to destroy his reactor.
We’ve decided to remove the teleports and use locomotion instead.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohs4fCyBAAsdfyCpq/giphy.gif[/img]


At the moment, we are busy testing this mode and fixing bugs ːsmileː
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4pTe5gwNZbsT4dfq/giphy.gif[/img]

Soon we will launch multiplayer in test mode, and, of course, we will be awaiting for your comments and suggestions about it!ːcall_soulmateː

notes.title: A huge update coming soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28302138/fc01fe3a8809de7dc16b40c6cc3d81df9aefd25b.jpg[/img]

Friends, we are happy to tell you that the global changes in the game are getting closer and closer!

Now we are testing VRobot in 4 hands, guess why?ːsmileː

That's right, we managed to get through the difficulties of making the multiplayer mode! You will be able to fight 1x1 with an opponent, using improvised means - at home, in a car, - very soon.

I will tell you even more: in this mode you will see a new system of movement - locomotion, - which you asked us to make in the comments for a lot of times. The old maps will still have a "teleport" functioning on them.

Also, we have prepared a new map specifically for the multiplayer mode.

Next time I will definitely tell you more about the new map, and also show how your VRobot will look in the game!

What kinds of weapons would you like to see in the new mode? Do not hesitate to write in the comments down below, we always do appreciate your opinion.

notes.title: Fly like a hummingbird!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28302138/e9079b165520adb051bef54a43209ac195fe3ac1.png[/img]
Greetings, friends!

Today is the Black Friday day, the best time to check sales and updates out! Let's begin with something pleasant - until the end of November, you will be able to purchase the game with a -45% discount.

And something about even more exciting - today I will tell you about the changes which are coming to the game with this patch.

[h1] Optimization: [/h1]
We've managed to reach the heights modern AAA-games only wish to reach - 90 FPS! To make it easier for you to imagine how fast is that - this is an average number of wing-strokes hummingbird makes per second (We mean a small hummingbird, just in case. Large hummingbirds clap their wings slower than our FPS before optimizationːsteamhappyː)

[h1]Hurricane improvement:[/h1]
We've told you about this enhancement in announcements - now the hurricane carries around not only houses but also robocitizens. And it became much higher, yep.

[h1]Hotfixes:[/h1]
We've fixed the «Pick up robo-citizen» achievement, now it is correctly given to everyone. Huge thanks to our community member, FunkeymonkeyTTR, who told us about this issue.

[h1]I can't wait to tell you more about our plans:[/h1]

Our programmer, Anton, is busy working with leaderboards. We wanted to add them to this version, but something went wrong. We will dedicate our time and efforts to fix the problem and make our best to make you happy as soon as possible. 

Our technical artist, Dima, is studying the question of locomotion in the game. You've asked us about this for multiple times, and we want not only to make it but to make it comfortable, which will take some time.

Our artist, Vadim, along with our game designer, Denis, are actively working on the new concept. We will share our thoughts in process.

Have a nice weekend!

notes.title: Why do designers not sleep?
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohBVif8zUP7A0QnqU/giphy.gif[/img]
Hello, friends.

Thank you very much for leaving your commentaries and ideas on how to make the game better!

We agree with you that it is fun to play now, but we wish the game's gameplay to become deeper, meaning it will be not only about "crash it all down". By speaking to our players, we've generated a few ideas on how to make the game more diverse and interesting. 

[h1]The first idea is to add strategic element.[/h1]
For now, it looks like so: people are moving to cities captured by the player. The player appoints governors for each city. Depending on the decisions made by the governors, the cities bring in resources and grant you access to new weapons (for example, tornado-gun can not be obtained without any efforts, it must be developed in one of the cities first). 
To make city life less measured and boring, we are going to add new events, such as monsters attack or meteor rain, which can affect the city like and demand player's attention. Your little governors can make decisions on their own, even wrong ones - for example, give the city back to robots.

[h1]The second idea is to give you an ability to build your own personal city.[/h1] 
But we are still rather skeptical about this idea, since you will undoubtedly want to attack the cities of other players, and this will turn the construction of a metropolis of your dreams into designing boring inaccessible boxes-fortresses.
That's why if we stick to this idea placement of every building will dictate player's access to weapons and its strength/range. For example, if you want the Tornado - build skyscrapers or something like that. 

[h1]We also have some nice ideas on developing the robocitizens' behavior systems[/h1] 
For example, you will gather a retinue of little robots with time, which will be able to penetrate some buildings' protective shield and destroy those from the inside, swim to a remote lighthouse, shoot down aircraft (friendly SuperRobot 3000)

[h1]And while our game designers are racking their brains, the hands of our programmers are actively working on improving the current functionality.[/h1]
Nikita made it possible for a tornado to spin rotocitizens and cars right round and carry them all away. Yes, they (and cars, and fragments of the houses) will now be sucked into the heart of the hurricane. 
Anton is busy with leaderboards configuration. If everything goes according to plan, you will be soon able to see how effectively do your friends destroy cities.

We are glad to hear all of your ideas and wishes out in commentaries!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Halloween update!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ov9jCF0QTyXhlHvsA/giphy.gif[/img]

The robots have studied the mankind archives for a long time and managed to learn that a portal of evil spirits will open on the last night of October. In order to prevent the catastrophe, they've replaced all the buildings in the city and their own robo-heads... with pumpkins. 

While seeds are inside of their heads instead of microcircuits, you can take an advantage of the situation and hit them in the "pumpkins".
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l1J9KSMyZgJWs56yk/giphy.gif[/img]

Hurry up! When the portal is closed, everything will get back to normal.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohhwGBJDlZiVmPmco/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1] You can purchase the game with -40% discount during the week! [/h1]

notes.content:

[i]Trick or treat![/i]

No chance in hell we are missing this holiday! Unfortunately, it is very hard to find a pumpkin in Russia this time of the year, and the hands of our designers and programmers are used to keyboards, not knives. So, it is easier for us to "code" a pumpkin, ehehːsteammockingː

Soon we will bring you a nice update, but until then - prepare your Jack-o'-lanterns!

[i]Trick or treat![/i]

notes.title: Meet the hammer!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ov9jMoj0KTkIOTnWM/giphy.gif[/img]
Hi guys,

A new update is here! What's new:

[h1]New weapon - hammer![/h1] 
To celebrate "Thor: Ragnarok" upcoming release, we've prepared a new type of weapon for you - the Hammer!
[list][*]It works like a real hammer - the larger the swing, the more powerful the blow;
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l0IsGoYjsRq5hUyQM/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] The Hammer can be used not only as a melee weapon but also as a throwing one. At the same time, the stronger the swing, the farther and faster the Hammer will fly; [img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7aCU8pDzGqGK3eA8/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] The Hammer can be charged up with lightning - just hold it over your head. The hit of a charged Hammer is pretty impressive;
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ov9jMoj0KTkIOTnWM/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] What is more, it returns back to your hands like a boomerang, to wherever part of the city you've moved to.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ov9kag5UTcrJEsvYY/giphy.gif[/img][/list]

Well, talk is cheap, better try it out yourself!ːsteamhappyː The Hammer can be used in "08", "Trurl" cities.

[h1]Robocitizen's improvements[/h1] 

Robocitizens are becoming more intelligent and more interesting to watch.
[list][*] They've learned to run away from the player in panic;
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ov9jOeRObftubUKdO/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] Now you can knock robocitizens down using your weapon, fists or even debris of the buildings;
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ov9jEQRwgHnRs9wmk/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] You can take any robocitizen by its hand or by its foot and cheerfully shake the poor fellow;
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l378crkwMShrbhUFG/giphy.gif[/img]
[*] And how high do they fly when you hit them with a charged up Hammer. 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohhwqll6pQPvDBKSc/giphy.gif[/img][/list]
[h1]Updated New York[/h1]

3. RoboYork city is becoming more and more like a real robot city for real VRobots.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Try Free Demo!
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUPJUqc6i80bluE6Sk/giphy.gif[/img]

Hi, guys! Miss us? Yes, i feel a little bit guilty because there were no new posts there for a long time. But i have a good reason; we made a really good thing. So i glad to introduce you (ta-daaa!) the Free VRobot's Demo!

Yes, the free demo of VRobot is available now. Since now you get a possibility of first game experience without any payment and can suggest improvements to the final version of the game based on this experience. 

[b]The demo includes the one city that you can destroy by bare hands of using the Great Transformer’s Sword.[/b]

Why we did this? We think that players deserve the fair play and can take part in development. And for VR games the strategy 'try/buy” is better, because players couldn’t do justice to this games just after watching promo videos and screenshots.  So, after playing the demo, every user can make size up and decide to buy our game or to suggest us some enhancement and after that to buy the full version of VRobot.

 In the full version players can get:

 - Different cities for destruction;
 - The new weapon - Tornado Maker;
 - The new weapon - Tractor Beam;
 - Cunning flying opponents;
 - Thrilling updates!

So, try the free demo, play VRobot, and save the planet!

P.S. Maybe, you noticed that VR market already made a huge step towards users. HTC Vive and Oculus reduced the price of helmets. And now it's a time for producers of the VR content to follow this trend and make their products more available for users. We've made this step too. And as John Lennon says, "come together, right now" :)

Cheers!

notes.title: New rules
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28302138/e6288c0ed241ca9ed710fc47b2a76f24d2bfd5c0.jpg[/img]

Hi, guys!

We decided to make an experiment! We gave control of the news on this account from the development team to the external observer because you know those game developers. They don't like to share the whole truth with you, they are closed. We decided to stop that. 

Players deserve to know everything about how the game is creating. 

This external observer will tell you about VRobot team work without any censorship. So, since that day we promise you:

 - more news about VRobot;

 - more inside information;

 - more revelations :)

But today was a usual day. Denis tried to jump out from the window because he saw a new color of Tractor Beam, Dmitry chose what NY district will be next (if you know what i mean), Anton kept silence, and you know that isn't a good omen.

Just a day in the indie studio. 

Soon we will tell you about the new building, which you will definitely want to destroy in our game (and maybe not only in the game) and about the news about the Summer Sale. 

Stay tuned, cheers!

P.S. If you want to push this team to work, vote for new features [url=https://trello.com/b/h9y2lIHM/vrobot-features]here! [/url]
